hints.title: Date String Parsing
hints.text: Parse the input date string into separate year, month, and day numeric values.

hints.title: Leap Year February Adjustment
hints.text: A leap year occurs if year is divisible by 4 and not 100, or if divisible by 400. In leap years, February has 29 days instead of 28.

hints.title: Accumulate Elapsed Days
hints.text: Sum the days in all completed months prior to the target month, and add the current day integer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: There are no edge cases beyond standard Gregorian leap year modular logic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant time month table lookup uses negligible auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement string splitting and the leap year test accurately.
complexity.notes: Format is guaranteed to be valid YYYY-MM-DD.
